content.text:
I'd go for Harel's stocks track (מניות) or the S&P 500 one. Fairly sure, but not sure enough to put the 30,000 in today. What got me was the number on the stocks track: **24.04%** a year over 3 years and 14.64% over 5. That's the biggest number on the page, and the track has 7.3 billion in it. The S&P one, which my friends keep talking about, shows 13.7% and 11.92%. The fees all look the same, about 0.55–0.57% and 0% on deposits, so fees don't decide it.

The catch is that all of this is under "קופת גמל להשקעה". That sounds like a pension thing for older people, and I'm not sure it's even where my money is with Harel. The page opened on that tab by itself. I never saw what the קרן השתלמות tab (16) shows.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** "הראל". Under it, a row of buttons for all Harel's products: תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים 16, קרן השתלמות 16, קופת גמל להשקעה 16 (already selected), קרן חדשה מקיפה 19, קרן חדשה כללית 18, חיסכון לכל ילד 4. That answers "what does Harel offer", more or less.
- **Below that:** a second row of buttons by track (S&P 500, מניות, אג"ח...). Then a line saying fees run from 0.54% to 0.61%.
- **The table:** I looked at the track name, the fee and the returns, plus the money column on the left. The first big number I saw was 106 million on "אשראי ואג"ח". After that, every row with less money looked small to me.
- **Most rows don't show a return.** They just say "פחות מ־3 שנים" / "פחות מ־5 שנים". So only a few tracks can be compared at all. Going from the 2nd screen to the 3rd, a few rows seemed to be missing.
- **Under the table:** a small grey "התקרה בחוק" line with 1.05% and 4%, and a note about returns being before fees. I didn't read them.
- **Folds I didn't open:** קרנות מחקות 5, מרכזיות לפיצויים, קרנות סל 4, and the whole "מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל" list. I almost opened קרנות סל because of the S&P, but the label doesn't say what's inside. At the bottom there's a search box, and that's where I'd have closed the page.

**Words I didn't get:** "מט"ח" (and the percentages next to it, like 99% stocks and 99% מט"ח in the same row), "קופה" with numbers like 15283, "ההפקדה" versus "החיסכון" under the fee, "תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים", "קרן חדשה מקיפה" / "כללית", "מרכזיות לפיצויים", "קרנות נאמנות", and "PF-10".

In the tab that was open, the stocks track shows 24.04% a year over 3 years and the S&P 500 track 13.7%, both at about 0.56% fee, so I'd lean to stocks or S&P. But it's all under 'קופת גמל להשקעה', which I'm not sure is for me, so I wouldn't move money today.
